reviews.review: This game is a lot of fun. It is very grindy in the beginning though so don't be discouraged! I'd say it's comparable to Destiny 2 but it doesn't have as good of a story line. It is, however, completely free! Unless you buy in game content of course. One of the things I hated most about Destiny 2... You need to buy a new expansion every 6 months or so to stay competitive in the game.
I really like this game. It is interesting and fun with friends. 10/10

First time I recommend long strong playsessions until you at least clear all the junctions. Youll have enough content thrown at you to keep you busy. After that, the quest are more out of the way but still easy to get and finnish. After youve farmed a bit (a lot) for general staple mods (you can ask in chat if anyone is willing to gift you basic mods, theree usually someone) and you suddenly feel like you hit a content wall (you dont but I felt like I did) around MR 10-14 then switch you playsessions to short targeted burst. Log in with a goal in mind like farm X warframe or Y resource. Keep the wiki close by on a tab and research what you need

Warframe is a good alternative if you don't have the expenses to buy Destiny's Bungie franchise, it's free to play all the way if you won't need on equipment or weapons slot (which will made you think twice), but aside this issue the game has beautiful design and textures. The mechanics of it might confuse you since it's a different level system compared to usual RPG games but with time you'll get used to it.

The game doesn't require much of hardware support which is very impressive considering that my graphic card have at least 5 to 7 years. So it runs fine if you have a decent graphic card video and hardware as the official minimum requirements recommend.

So just to end, you might want it try this game if you like Destiny, It's very fun in the beginning, you will might just tire of it if you want to proceed to advanced quests as the missions and some scenarios becomes repetitive as you step forward in the game.

A lot of people have a lot of opinions about this game, yet if i need to give one tip if you are reading reviews to decide if you want to play this game or not, just try the game out for yourself, even after having played this game for more then 200 hours i still find myself coming back to this game, maybe you don't like it and you stop with maybe a hour but then you would miss so much of the content that this game has to offer.
